On 06/22/2015 04:46 AM, Holipah Math10 wrote:
> dear all
> I'm taking about multigrup thesis. the data that I use is the data
> simulation. I ask how the script to include "group" or create a "group"
> itself in the data simulation? Please help me

For multiple group data generation, two things are important:

1) use a vector of values to specify population values, eg

model <- ' f =~ c(1,1)*x1 + c(0.8,0.6)*x2 + c(0.5,0.7)*x3 '

2) sample.nobs is a vector, with a sample size for each group, eg

Data <- simulateData(model, sample.nobs = c(200,300))

Yves.
